name: 学習に使う資源の見出し
prompt:
Create ONE isolated Japanese learning-resource header row on a pure white canvas. Input 1 ORIGINAL Duolingo screenshot is PRIMARY for every icon's shape, optical weight, proportions, spacing and alignment. Inputs 3 and 4 are protected original Italian flag and flame artwork: retain their exact colors and geometry. Input 2 Japanese mock is SECONDARY for wording and locked text roles; it incorrectly clips the gem, omits the purple energy battery, and colors all values green. Input 5 is approved Lighthouse finish only; no bus content.
Scope only source region x73 y194 width1035 height103 in1180x2676. No unit header, path, navigation, status bar, captions or borders. A compact row about390x46 logical units, white background, four balanced groups centered vertically:
1. Exact original Italian flag from input3, about32x26, same vertical green/white/red proportions and corner shape.
2. Exact original yellow-edged coral flame from input4, about20x26, followed by numeral「8」in source coral-orange. Preserve flame silhouette, white center, yellow perimeter and coral fill.
3. Restore COMPLETE cyan-blue faceted hexagonal gem from the ORIGINAL FULL SCREENSHOT input1, about22x26, with the original pale top-left facet. Do NOT copy the mock's clipped half-gem or the badly clipped derivative. Follow with exact「631」in the source cyan-blue.
4. Restore the ORIGINAL purple rounded energy-battery glyph with its small right terminal, pale corner highlight and white lightning bolt, about24x24. Follow with Japanese「無制限」in source deep purple, replacing the original infinity text with the native Japanese wording.
ALL numerals and Japanese text are Meiryo REGULAR40012px with16px line height and zero letter spacing. Fine normal strokes, no bold. Exact values8,631,無制限. Fit all groups within the row without overlap. Preserve the meaningful resource colors; these are semantic status artwork and values, not arbitrary utility icon colors. No forest primary action is present. Ordinary canvas stays pure white. Do not reinterpret or redraw protected artwork, add badges, or invent extra resources. One high-resolution flat UI raster.
reviewNotes: Inspected: complete gem and missing energy icon restored; semantic coral/cyan/purple retained on white. Numerals use rounded heavy source-like lettering instead of locked Meiryo Regular12; 無制限 also heavy. Protected flame/flag contours and color still reconstructed. One targeted correction follows.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
